follow_player.name: follow_player
follow_player.description: Follows the specified player or nearest player safely

collect_drops.name: collect_drops
collect_drops.description: Scans and collects nearby dropped items and loot

craft_item.name: craft_item
craft_item.description: Crafts an item with automated crafting table lifecycle

chop_tree.name: chop_tree
chop_tree.description: Chops nearby trees and replants saplings

defend_area.name: defend_area
defend_area.description: Guards the perimeter against hostile mobs

sleep_bed.name: sleep_bed
sleep_bed.description: Finds nearest bed and sleeps through the night

mine_ore.name: mine_ore
mine_ore.description: Mines specific ores or staircase mines towards target level

smelt_item.name: smelt_item
smelt_item.description: Smelts raw ores or food in furnace

staircase_mine.name: staircase_mine
staircase_mine.description: Mines a diagonal 1x2 staircase down to target depth

go_surface.name: go_surface
go_surface.description: Navigates back to the surface level

swim_up.name: swim_up
swim_up.description: Emergency surface swimming and cave ceiling air pocket excavation

mine_remembered_ore.name: mine_remembered_ore
mine_remembered_ore.description: Navigates to previously remembered ore coordinates and harvests them

explore_terrain.name: explore_terrain
explore_terrain.description: Wanders around the terrain within a given radius safely

branch_mine.name: branch_mine
branch_mine.description: Fishbone / branch mining pattern at current level

explore_cave.name: explore_cave
explore_cave.description: Explores nearby cave system, torches dark areas and collects exposed ores

shaft_mine.name: shaft_mine
shaft_mine.description: 2x1 safe vertical shaft mining down to target Y level

strip_mine.name: strip_mine
strip_mine.description: Mines a straight horizontal tunnel at current level

recover_table.name: recover_table
recover_table.description: Finds nearby placed crafting table, breaks and recovers it to inventory

hunt_animal.name: hunt_animal
hunt_animal.description: Hunts nearby passive animals (chicken, cow, pig, sheep) for food and drops

navigate_landmark.name: navigate_landmark
navigate_landmark.description: Navigates to a recorded landmark from spatial memory (e.g. SurfaceSpawn, MineEntrance, HomeBed, LastDeathPoint)

deposit_chest.name: deposit_chest
deposit_chest.description: Deposits surplus materials and junk into the nearest registered memory chest or nearby chest
